info.title: VNC Remote Control Server API
info.description: Authenticated HTTP API for observing and controlling one project-owned Debian desktop. All /v1 routes require one process-wide bearer token loaded from a secret file. Command endpoints use bounded asynchronous HTTP 202 semantics: validation, worker execution, and worker acknowledgement complete before the response, but target application semantics are not guaranteed. The HTTP/1 runtime may close incomplete headers at the transport level and may return empty 400, 408, or 413 responses before Axum routing.

servers.description: Default loopback binding; use TLS at a trusted reverse proxy beyond localhost.

get.description: Ready only when shutdown has not begun, the worker is connected and nonfatal, and a complete current framebuffer with dimensions and timestamp exists.

200.description: Controller can serve current desktop operations.

503.description: Controller is starting, reconnecting, lacks a current complete framebuffer, has a fatal worker exit, or is shutting down.

200.description: Coherent RGBA framebuffer encoded as PNG.

304.description: If-None-Match matched the current process-instance and framebuffer revision.

get.description: Supports If-None-Match. Screenshot work uses bounded concurrent permits and a bounded encode deadline.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade accepted. The first text frame is a snapshot, followed by payload-free revision and lifecycle events.

503.description: Configured WebSocket client capacity or the process-local event sequence is exhausted.

get.description: OpenAPI describes the HTTP upgrade only. See docs/WEBSOCKET_EVENTS.md for the exact event envelope, heartbeat behavior, and close codes.

200.description: Prometheus text exposition with bounded labels and no payload or secret values.

post.description: No request body. Automatic reconnect remains active for transport loss; this endpoint is not a polling mechanism.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque process-wide token read by the controller from VRC_API_TOKEN_FILE. Never place it in URLs or logs.

XRequestId.description: Accepted client request ID or a controller-generated process-local ID.

text.description: Last valid inbound UTF-8 clipboard value.

ApiKeyboardKey.description: A documented symbolic key name or exactly one printable ASCII character. Raw numeric keysyms are invalid.

delta_x.description: Horizontal scrolling is not supported in v0.1; nonzero values return 422 invalid_request.

keys.description: Pressed in array order and released in reverse order without interleaving another worker command.

text.description: Maximum 16 KiB. Supports tab, CR, LF, and printable ASCII only. The complete value is preflighted before input begins.
Valid UTF-8, maximum 1 MiB measured in encoded bytes, with no embedded NUL.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or incorrect bearer token. Authentication failures are deliberately indistinguishable.

InvalidJson.description: Malformed JSON or an invalid JSON media payload.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Global JSON body limit or operation-specific text/clipboard limit exceeded. A pre-router runtime rejection may close the connection with an empty 413 body.

RequestBodyTimeout.description: The complete request body was not received within VRC_HTTP_BODY_TIMEOUT_MS. The runtime closes the connection and returns an empty 408 response.

InvalidRequest.description: The request failed complete preflight, including coordinates, unsupported values, or operation-specific constraints.

InternalError.description: Unexpected internal failure. The response and logs remain payload-free.

DesktopOperationFailed.description: The VNC transport, authentication, protocol, or native operation failed.

WorkerUnavailable.description: Worker, framebuffer, clipboard, queue, screenshot capacity, readiness, or shutdown state prevents the operation.

CommandTimeout.description: Worker acknowledgement or screenshot encoding exceeded its configured deadline.

ReconnectRateLimited.description: Manual reconnect was requested before the configured interval elapsed.
